name: Ponpoko-Pon!

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text:
Whether it's because you play especially vigorously or are simply off-key, the music of your belly drum can physically wound your foes. You deal ceil(@actor.level/2)d4 sonic damage to all creatures in a 30-foot cone, with a basic Fortitude save save equal to your spell DC or class DC, whichever is higher. Such vigorous drumming does leave your belly a bit sore, though, preventing you from using this ability again for 1d4 rounds.

At 15th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4.
